title: Uniform refinement of a weighted experiment
statement: A uniform refinement of a weighted constraint experiment $E$ consists of a finite, nonempty set of occurrences, an outcome in $E$ for each occurrence, and the requirement that mapping the uniform probability distribution on the occurrences to their outcomes gives exactly the law of $E$.
hypotheses_covered: each occurrence is assigned an outcome of $E$
the outcome map pushes the uniform law on occurrences to the law of $E$
